title: Sigiriya & Dambulla Day Tour
seoTitle: Sigiriya & Dambulla Day Tour | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private Sigiriya and Dambulla day tour from Colombo with Hai Sri Lanka Tours.
shortDescription: Climb Lion Rock and visit the golden cave temples on a private Cultural Triangle day.
overview:
A private Cultural Triangle day built around two of Sri Lanka's greatest landmarks: the climb of Sigiriya Rock Fortress and a visit to the golden cave temples of Dambulla.
Travel scenic countryside roads with generous pacing, time for photos, and space to appreciate ancient water gardens, frescoes, and panoramic summit views before your return journey.
